scope: English YouTube Shorts returned by three vidIQ outlier searches for smash burgers, crisp food, and luxury food. This is a small discovery sample, not a global top-ten ranking or a forecast for Billionaire Bites.
channelContext: The vidIQ connection returned no owned YouTube channels. BB retention, audience fit, and actual upload signatures are unknown.
sourcePolicy: Use the linked videos as research evidence. Make original recipes, footage, sounds, hooks, and edits; clear music rights before publishing.

patterns.name: Finished bite, then earn it
patterns.hookMechanism: Show the finished texture in the first second, then reveal the physical work that created it.
patterns.montageDirection: Finished macro -> heat action -> texture change -> assembly -> finished close view. Cut on spatula contact, cheese placement and bun landing rather than an arbitrary flash.
originalHookExamples: Will this crust hold the cheese?
Hear what happens when it hits the griddle.
patterns.proposedSound: Use original or cleared sizzle, steel scrape and one crisp finishing contact; no voice when the actions are self-explanatory.
patterns.continuityGate: Count patties and buns in every actual clip, then check hand, tool, plate and set across the cut.

patterns.name: Heat creates a visible edge
patterns.evidenceConfidence: three independent channel title/cover examples; only one scene-reviewed
patterns.hookMechanism: A crisping edge, steam plume or melting cheese gives the viewer a specific texture to wait for.
patterns.montageDirection: Hold enough frames to see the heat change, then cut to the next contact action; use a close griddle view and an unobstructed side view of the finished layers.
originalHookExamples: Watch the edge turn into lace.
patterns.proposedSound: Lead with pan contact and scrape; leave kitchen room tone between actions, with no compulsory music.
patterns.continuityGate: Do not approve a model clip that duplicates meat, changes the pan or teleports cheese.

patterns.name: Plain outside, surprising center
patterns.evidenceConfidence: one scene-reviewed example and one title/cover example
patterns.hookMechanism: A familiar shape hides a specific ingredient or construction detail that the reveal explains.
patterns.montageDirection: Show the object -> assemble the center -> cook or chill -> cut or open it -> hold the proof. Keep the vessel and ingredient amounts consistent.
originalHookExamples: What is inside this golden bite?
This looks like dessert until the cut.
patterns.proposedSound: For an original ASMR version, emphasize siphon, gentle fry, plate tap and crisp opening. The source's music is not a licence to reuse it.
patterns.continuityGate: The payoff must visibly show the promised center; do not imply an ingredient absent from the frames.

patterns.name: One small technique, audible payoff
patterns.evidenceConfidence: one metadata-only example; technique and result unverified
patterns.hookMechanism: Promise a practical texture change and show the one action that causes it.
patterns.montageDirection: Texture problem -> one visible correction -> heat -> controlled crack test. Do not call it a secret unless the technique is actually shown.
originalHookExamples: One step before the fry makes the snap.
patterns.proposedSound: Clear fry and break sounds; use brief voice or a label only if the technique cannot be inferred visually.
patterns.continuityGate: Verify the before and after are the same food batch and the stated technique is plausible.

patterns.name: A dish reaches the table
patterns.evidenceConfidence: one metadata-only example; no scene analysis
patterns.hookMechanism: A service deadline gives plating a clear story goal instead of a collection of attractive shots.
patterns.montageDirection: One plate waiting -> final cooking constraint -> precise finish -> carry to the table -> diner-facing reveal.
originalHookExamples: The last garnish before the door opens.
patterns.proposedSound: Pan finish, tweezer contact, quiet room tone and a final plate set-down; optional sparse voice when the service stakes need explanation.
patterns.continuityGate: Track the same plate, garnish, chef sleeve and set from kitchen to table.
